name: 1social-threads
description: A Threads posting workflow for the 1Social connector: write a post that fits Threads' 500 characters, attach images or a video, check it against Threads' limits, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Write and publish posts to Threads without leaving the chat. Share an idea, a draft or a longer piece, and get a post that fits Threads' 500 characters and sounds like a conversation, not an ad. Add images or a video, check the post against Threads' limits before anything goes out, then publish now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the post actually landed, with a link to it. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a Threads account connected to your 1Social account.
defaultPrompt: Write a Threads post about our new feature and publish it.
Shorten this LinkedIn post for Threads and schedule it for tonight at 7pm.
Post this photo to Threads with a short caption.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: guided Threads posting and scheduling over the 1Social connector.
